name: DeskComm CRM
use_label: CRM for businesses that sell by chat
one_liner: Runs a self-hosted CRM with built-in AI agents and WhatsApp chat.

text.why: Where orders arrive by chat, conversation history and customer records end up split between a messenger and a spreadsheet. deskcommcrm keeps a CRM, native AI agents and WhatsApp in one self-hosted package. It is multi-tenant, MCP-ready, written in TypeScript and published under MIT. The homepage domain and its LGPD note place it in the Brazilian market.
text.take: A CRM for businesses selling by chat; the installer covers domain, database and keys, but you run the server.
build: An internal CRM that takes chat orders and keeps the customer record
Chat support automation that handles first contact and hands over

who.situation: logs WhatsApp enquiries and orders in one place
lets AI handle first contact and keeps the record
needs a self-hosted CRM built around LGPD

start.text: Prepare a Docker-capable VPS (4 GB RAM advised), a domain, a Supabase account and an LLM key
Then open https://<your-domain> and scan the WhatsApp QR code

caveat: Docs and UI are Portuguese-first (English and Spanish READMEs exist)
You supply the VPS, domain, Supabase project, LLM key and WhatsApp number
The README leads with an affiliate link to one hosting provider (HostGator)

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
